headline: Small but rideable with clean afternoon wind — a fun log session.
today: Mixed short and mid-period south energy to about 1.9ft, nothing pushy but workable. Morning is cross, then WNW goes cross-off in the afternoon and cleans it up — that's your window. Log or fish it.

daysToWatch.note: Clean and glassy — ESE at 9s with offshore morning going light. Small at 1.6ft but the quality's there for a mellow longboard session.
Cross-on building to 22mph onshore by evening — bumpy and deteriorating, low priority.
The day to rearrange plans for: swell to 5-plus feet on a good south angle with NW cross-off through the morning. Get there early before the afternoon SW cross-on shows up. Shortboard weather.
Leftover 2-3ft with cross-off morning wind — solid follow-up session while it holds.
